What if you were invisible in real life?
To be invisible, light has to pass straight through you, without bouncing off or being absorbed.
But your eyes only see by catching light. The retina at the back has to absorb it.
So if light passed straight through your eyes… you'd be completely blind.
And if you kept your eyes visible, so you could see, people would spot two eyeballs floating in the air.
Real scientists are building invisibility cloaks. So far, they only work for some colours, or for tiny objects.
Would you still want to be invisible, if it meant being blind? Tell me in the comments.
